delivery.outcome: All six legacy adapter namespaces are executable compatibility facades over canonical Koru implementations, with no remaining protobuf helper behavior in dsl2coru.
nonGoals: Delete legacy distributions before the required compatibility release
Edit dependency manifests or integration-owned documentation
Change DSL grammar, protobuf wire fields or command semantics

architecture.decision: Let canonical protobuf text helpers select project or file context, expose them as direct legacy aliases and enforce all namespace pairs through one AST-and-entrypoint conformance matrix.
interfaceChanges: dsl2koru.pb_codec.encode_text_to_protobuf accepts an optional default_file compatibility context
architecture.rollback: Revert the protected merge to restore the legacy protobuf wrappers and remove the cross-family conformance suite.

commands: PYTHONPATH=<all adapter source roots> python -m pytest -q tests/test_namespace_pair_conformance.py packages/dsl2koru/tests packages/dsl2coru/tests
validation.evidence: canonical and compatibility protobuf plus namespace matrix
deterministic local and protected delivery gates
